verdict: Both ad channels went dark this week; reactivation is underway now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 106 leads at an average cost of $16.40 per lead — but that activity came to a hard stop on September 17, when both Meta and Google stopped spending entirely. In the most recent 7 days, leads dropped 88% versus the prior 7 days and cost per lead jumped 81%, not from gradual fatigue but from a full channel outage. Reactivating both channels is the immediate priority, and infrastructure that was blocking that reactivation is being resolved this week. Once campaigns are live again, lead volume should return toward the pace seen in the first three weeks of this period.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta
drop in leads this past week versus the week before, due to both channels going dark
average cost per lead over the full 28-day window

watch_item.issue: Meta and Google have had zero spend for 6 consecutive days, halting all new leads.
watch_item.fix: Both channels are being reactivated this week; the underlying infrastructure verification that blocked them is being completed now.
